parameters.content:
## Apartments.com Rental Listing & Floor Plan Scraper

**Actor:** [Apartments.com Rental Listing & Floor Plan Scraper](https://apify.com/dataspryva/apartments-com-rental-listing-and-floor-plan)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/apartments-com-rental-listing-and-floor-plan-scraper.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string)
- `searchLocation` (string)
- `bedrooms` (string)
- `bathrooms` (string)
- `priceMin` (integer)
- `priceMax` (integer)
- `sqftMin` (integer)
- `sqftMax` (integer)
- `propertyType` (string)
- `petPolicy` (string)
- `amenities` (array)
- `rentSpecials` (boolean)

### Output fields
- `name` (Name)
- `address` (Address)
- `city` (City)
- `state` (State)
- `zipCode` (Zip Code)
- `priceMin` (Price Min)
- `priceMax` (Price Max)
- `priceCurrency` (Price Currency)
- `bedsMin` (Beds Min)
- `bedsMax` (Beds Max)
- `propertyType` (Property Type)
- `rating` (Rating)

description: Apartments.com rental listing scraper: runs the Apartments.com Rental Listing & Floor Plan Scraper Apify Actor, returns name, address, priceMin, priceMax, priceCurrency and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
